summary: Vinton County, OH: Oreton Tower Site, FFLOS US 1581 (registered 2014); now listed as gone; a route guide says a road in Vinton Furnace State Forest once led to it.

facts.status_note: Listed as 'Tower Gone' on the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Ohio list; a Find a Grave page calls the tower 'defunct'

access.note: Route guide places the former road in Vinton Furnace State Forest, which it says is open daily 6 am to 11 pm per ODNR; no source describes the tower site itself

visit.trail_note: A dead-end gravel road once led to the tower; no source describes what is at the site now

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no source read gives a build date, staffing, or fire events for the Oreton tower. The Forest Lookouts Oreton page holds only the name and county, so it is not cited. The Find a Grave page is user-contributed. The route guide calls the forest both 'State Forest' and 'State Park' and a ghost-town guide places Oreton near Zaleski State Forest with different coordinates; the story follows the route guide's forest name and does not cite the ghost-town guide. The FFLOS coordinates (39.171167, -82.381472) are not reconciled with the town's coordinates. The route guide's hours are attributed to ODNR but the ODNR page was not read directly. No photos found. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story no longer says Oreton 'grew up' as a mining town, since Wikipedia says only that it was a New York Coal Company mining town; the Find a Grave page places the gate near the tower's location, not the tower itself.
